Future<void> run(items) async {
 for (final item in items) {
  Future<void> callback() async { await write(item); }
  callbacks.add(callback);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await callback();
  Future<void> nested() async {
   for (final child in children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await write(child);
   }
  }
  callbacks.add(nested);
 }
}
